outcome: Neonatal acquisition of extended spectrum beta-lactamase-producing enterobacteriaceae (ESBL-PE)
cohort: Newborns in urban and semi-rural areas of Madagascar
finding: Maternal use of antibiotics at delivery, cesarean section, and low birth weight were independently associated with increased risk of neonatal ESBL-PE acquisition.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was identified as an independent risk factor for ESBL-PE acquisition in newborns.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was an independent risk factor for ESBL-PE acquisition.
